label: Exploratory V5 F4 with direct-cast range-entry commitment candidate I1
assumptions: This is not nimble-knots-artillery-v5 and has no runtime, replay, protocol, reward, UI, asset, or product authority.

It keeps Candidate F4's complete ideal-direct-hit values and tactical core: 30/45/80 damage, 640/576/512 ranges, forward Seam Pin, equal 128 Escape Slack, prepared Spoolburst, Spun Cocoon, and compulsory 64-unit Threadback Unweave.

An ordinary direct cast that is illegal before movement but legal after its own movement is unavailable as a combined action. The actor may instead relocate, ending the turn; the opponent receives one ordinary turn; and a later cast is legal only if the later tactical carrier remains in band.
The commitment is a witnessed path role, not a status or reserved future cast. It adds no resource, special response, reaction action, or persistent tactical-state field.

Stationary and already-in-band direct casts remain ordinary move-and-cast actions. Spoolburst preparation, stationary release, Threadball Unweave, Threadback, Seam Pin, Escape Slack, values, movement, policies, and search depth are unchanged.
Terrain, aim, trajectory, splash, player skill, live Loomkeeper behavior, animation, UI, replay, reward, and production counter-effects remain excluded.
